module.pretestIntro: A few questions to check what you already know. This pre-test does not count: it is used to measure your progress.

prefs.intro: Adapt the display to your needs. Your choices apply immediately and are stored only in this browser.
prefs.apercu: Preview: here is sample text with a link and a button.
prefs.stockageIndisponible: Local storage is unavailable in this browser: your preferences apply to this page but will not be kept.
accueil.choisirProfilIntro: Each profile has a learning path tailored to its tasks and to the priority risks of {org}.
accueil.resumeParcours: {n} modules, about {minutes} minutes in total, {obligatoires} of them mandatory.
accueil.deroule1: discover the threat and test what you already know.
accueil.deroule2: a short lesson (10 minutes), also in an easy-read version.
accueil.deroule3: practise on realistic cases, with no risk at all.
accueil.deroule4: pass the post-test ({seuil} %): your parries join your deck.
accueil.pourTous1: Every module is available in an easy-read version.
accueil.pourTous2: You can enlarge the text, choose a font suited to dyslexia or low vision, a dark theme or high contrast:
accueil.pourTous3: Everything works with a keyboard and a screen reader. No activity is timed.
accueil.pilotage1: completion, scores and delays by profile.
accueil.pilotage2: actions for the year and renewal frequencies.
accueil.pilotage3: the full awareness plan, ready to export.
profils.intro: Users do not have the same tasks or the same exposure to risks. The programme defines {n} profiles, each with its own needs, learning objectives and a learning path computed from the risk assessment of {org}.
profils.resume: {objectifs} learning objectives – {modules} modules – {minutes} minutes (yearly target: {cible} minutes).
profil.enregistre: This profile is saved as yours.
profil.stockageIndisponible: Could not save: local storage is unavailable.
profil.objectifsIntro: By the end of the learning path, the person is able to:
profil.objectifsLegende: Objectives, target level and the modules that teach and assess them
profil.exposition: Risks this profile is particularly exposed to
profil.nonPrioritaire: not a priority in the current risk assessment
profil.parcoursExplication: The order is computed automatically: the mandatory core first, then the modules covering the organisation's priority risks (a risk counts double when this profile is particularly exposed to it).
profil.categorie.prioritaire: Priority modules (based on the risk assessment)
profil.nonCouverts: Priority risks of the organisation not addressed in this learning path: {risques}. They are covered by other profiles' learning paths or by technical measures.
modules.intro: {n} short modules, each made up of a pre-test, key points, a scenario and a post-test. Every module is available in a standard version and an easy-read version.
module.nonTraduit: This module has not been translated yet: it is shown in its original language (French).
progression.intro: Your results are stored only in this browser. Compare your pre-test (before the module) with your post-test (after the module) to measure your progress. A module is passed with at least {seuil} % in the post-test.
progression.aucunProfil: No profile chosen: all modules are shown.
progression.profil: Profile: {profil}. Only the modules in your learning path are shown.
progression.effacerIntro: You can delete your results and saved profile from this browser at any time.
prefs.zoom: Browser zoom (Ctrl and +, or Cmd and + on Mac) works on every page, up to 400 %.
prefs.systeme: Your system's accessibility settings (text size, reduced motion, dark theme) are respected when “Follow device setting” is selected.
calendrier.intro: This calendar is generated automatically from the frequencies set in the configuration of {org} and from the priority risks: the highest-priority modules are reviewed first.
calendrier.frequencesLegende: Frequency of each type of action
calendrier.freq.bilan: Review, yearly post-test and plan update
calendrier.lancement.description: Message from management, diagnostic pre-tests for every profile and opening of the learning paths.
calendrier.accueil.titre: Onboarding path (ongoing, within {jours} days of each arrival)
calendrier.accueil.description: Every newcomer completes their mandatory path within the set time, then joins the path of their job profile.
calendrier.simulation.description: Educational scenario within the platform (no real email), followed by immediate feedback and measurement of reporting rates.
calendrier.rappel.description: Reminders for unfinished modules, consolidation post-tests and quick reference cards.
calendrier.renouvellement.description: Module to be renewed on a {frequence} basis (evolving threat).
calendrier.veille.description: Modules updated based on threat monitoring (generative AI, deepfakes, QR codes, incident feedback and threat landscape reports).
calendrier.crise.description: Tabletop exercise based on a ransomware scenario, with management, line managers and the IT team.
calendrier.bilan.description: Yearly post-tests, analysis of indicators by profile, update of the risk assessment and of the plan for the following year.
tdb.fictifDetail: Population of {n} people generated automatically from the headcount and profiles in the configuration, as of {date}. No real results are collected.
tdb.kpiScores: average score before (pre-test) and after (post-test) the modules
tdb.kpiReussite: of post-tests reach the {seuil} % pass mark
tdb.kpiRetard: people have at least one overdue module (more than {jours} days)
tdb.graphCompletion: Learning path completion rate by profile
tdb.graphScores: Average score before and after the modules, by profile
tdb.graphSimulations: Click rate and reporting rate by simulation campaign
tdb.simulationsIntro: Scenarios within the platform (no real email). Goal: lower the click rate and raise the reporting rate.
tdb.aucuneSimulation: No simulation has taken place yet at the reference date.
tdb.retardsLegende: Modules not completed after {jours} days, by profile (largest numbers first)
